banner.title: GATE DA Atlas
banner.subtitle: Official GATE DA questions, mapped to the syllabus

architecture.alt: Pipeline in five phases: fetch, parse and validate the official PDFs; tag every question with reference, ML, LLM and hybrid taggers and evaluate them; analyse weightage and forecast; plan study hours; export to the web atlas
architecture.input: 14 official PDFs: 3 papers, 3 answer keys, 8 syllabi

steps.title: Fetch
lines: Every official mirror; only byte-identical copies are kept (SHA-256)

steps.title: Parse
lines: Glyph positions give questions, options, scripts and a crop of each question

steps.title: Validate
lines: 65 questions and 100 marks a paper, 41 checks; lossy text goes to needs_review

rows.pill: 195 questions  ·  136 syllabus items with their official phrases

steps.title: Reference
lines: One AI annotator tags every question; frozen before any tagger runs

steps.title: ML
lines: bge-small embeddings, few-shot kNN with nested cross-validation

steps.title: LLM
lines: gpt-oss-120b on Groq, strict JSON schema; hybrid mode picks from the ML top 15

steps.title: Evaluate
lines: Accuracy, Cohen's kappa and McNemar tests against the reference

rows.band: Phases 3 to 5: analysis, planner, web atlas

steps.title: Weightage
lines: Marks per item, cluster and section; trends; never-asked items

steps.title: Forecast
lines: Empirical-Bayes Gamma-Poisson per item, backtested paper by paper

steps.title: Planner
lines: KKT hour allocation, spaced revision, mocks, Beta updates

steps.title: Web atlas
lines: Static React app; the planner is a parity-tested TypeScript port
